rationale: Dylan and Jawad both focus on vertical AI-SaaS and LLM tooling, with Dylan's hands-on expertise in scaling AI-powered career guidance complemented by Jawad's experience advising early-stage startups on momentum and introductions. Jawad's track record founding and scaling ventures (Macrohedge, now Collaborative Intelligence) and his On Deck Fellowship background could offer valuable operational perspective for Casey AI's growth, while Dylan's GTM framework from reaching #1 at Salesforce and his domain-level research in edtech/career-AI could inform Jawad's current AI-focused venture.
